hook.name: StrategyHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook (pmav.fun V2) that creates coins with 1B fixed supply trading on a concentrated bonding curve. Enforces block+1 anti-snipe, first-hour per-wallet 2% cap with auto-refund, and 2% flat fees split among platform (0.25%), creator (0.25–0.75%), and a dividend treasury. Graduation converts the curve position to a permanently locked full-range LP in the same pool.
